mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and foggy near Fireman's Park under a first quarter moon, with an overnight low of 60 degrees and rain expected.
Road maintenance begins September 23 with chip sealing on Cross Country Road and other areas, and the City is also reviewing various development projects for the October 5 meeting.
Today features the Sugar River BBQ Festival and various live music spots, while tomorrow you can head to Badger Prairie County Park for the Bike the Barns fundraiser.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old was taken into custody after a shot was fired during the incident.
Culver's is currently closed today for a facility remodel, so please look forward to their return soon.
